关键词: Power systems|level design|combat boundaries|fighting above one's level
意图与同义词: Designing levels|Avoiding broken power scaling|Winning across levels
大模型指令: Give every major tier a perceptible qualitative change, combat benchmark, and breakthrough threshold; specify exceptions that allow lower-level victories.
核心摘要: Each advancement needs visible change; cross-level wins should require intelligence, counters, or a high price.
详细展开: Frequent effortless victories over higher ranks remove their threat, while levels without new features quickly destroy the sense of growth.
数值控制边界: Specify qualitative change|combat benchmark|breakthrough conditions for each tier; lower-tier victories require counters|information|environment|cost and cannot be routine.
与剧情交互方式: Structures growth feedback, intimidating power gaps, resource competition, and social hierarchy.

关键词: Power side effects|ability costs|usage limits|equivalent exchange
意图与同义词: Designing side effects|Balancing strong abilities|Superpower costs
大模型指令: Stronger abilities need clear recurring costs; mitigating those costs should itself become a plotline.
核心摘要: Side effects prevent runaway power and create continuing choice pressure and tension.
详细展开: Costs may involve lifespan, sanity, pain, calories, organ damage, or social risk; scale them with power and make them affect later decisions.
数值控制边界: Define duration|trigger conditions|recovery costs; mitigation must also be scarce and costly.
与剧情交互方式: Creates crisis choices, resource pursuits, main and side goals, and sacrifice.

关键词: System fiction|special advantage|growth systems|upgrade boundaries
意图与同义词: Designing systems|Limiting special powers|Keeping cheats balanced|System upgrade limits
大模型指令: Separate core functions, unlock conditions, and limiting rules so the system cannot solve everything.
核心摘要: A growth system creates payoffs, but its upgrades, cooldowns, missions, and failure costs must remain traceable.
详细展开: Each upgrade should match a new story stage; unconditional answers in every situation rapidly eliminate protagonist agency.
数值控制边界: Keep core functions limited; each unlock requires conditions|cooldowns|missions|failure costs; do not release every strong function early.
与剧情交互方式: Drives growth, chapter hooks, and resource allocation while serving rather than replacing the main plot.

关键词: Faction structure|court factionalism|power contests|multiparty balance
意图与同义词: Designing factions|Building political divisions|Structuring multiparty intrigue
大模型指令: Define each faction's interests, weaknesses, and hidden cards before slogans or allegiances.
核心摘要: Stable factional settings arise from conflicting interests and balances, not merely good versus evil.
详细展开: Three or more sides create room for maneuver if every faction has nonnegotiable interests and exploitable shortcomings.
数值控制边界: Specify core interests|leaders|visible weaknesses|hidden cards; alliances and betrayals must trace back to changing interests.
与剧情交互方式: Builds long-term conflict networks, political reversals, and maneuvering space between powers.

关键词: Multiverse fiction|cross-world travel|home world and missions|relative time rates
意图与同义词: Designing multiverse stories|Writing travel mechanics|Balancing home-world and mission time
大模型指令: Define the travel medium, cooldown, carrying limits, and return conditions before compatibility rules; prohibit cost-free stacking of every world's powers.
核心摘要: Lock down travel, time rates, transport limits, and return conditions; mission rewards must coexist with home-world costs.
详细展开: One home-world day equaling a mission year affects age, resources, and chronology. Without cooldowns and entry requirements, travel becomes unlimited farming; cross-world powers need conversion losses or adaptation conditions.
数值控制边界: Specify medium|cooldown|carrying limits|return conditions; power transfer requires losses or thresholds.
与剧情交互方式: Changes mission goals, creates time arbitrage and pressure to return, and turns compatibility into puzzles or resource planning.

关键词: System shops|price anchors|shop economy|loot-box spending
意图与同义词: Pricing system shops|Designing shop prices|Pricing resurrection coins
大模型指令: Set currency income and three price bands first, then an expensive ultimate item; do not alter prices arbitrarily to suit the plot.
核心摘要: Everyday consumables, mid-tier upgrades, and prohibitively costly ultimate items provide immediate satisfaction and long-term saving goals.
详细展开: Resurrection coins or fate-changing vouchers establish distant ambitions; discounts, random boxes, and resource gaps drive immediate choices. Prices must form a coherent loop with income.
数值控制边界: Establish consumable|mid-tier function|ultimate-goal price bands; price growth must track currency production.
与剧情交互方式: Uses ultimate items for long goals and discounts|purchase limits|loot boxes for short-term spending choices and resource anxiety.

关键词: Academy fiction|timetables|ranking battles|student factions
意图与同义词: Building an academy setting|Designing classes and exams|Writing house rankings
大模型指令: Interlock classes, assessments, and factions; pay classroom knowledge off in practical trials and rankings instead of disguising an arena as a school.
核心摘要: A school needs a working cycle of teaching, assessment, and factional competition, not only a name and gifted students.
详细展开: Basic lessons plant setups, monthly exams or field trials reveal differences in skill, and clubs, councils, or houses sustain resource competition.
设定类型: Linked academy curriculum, assessment, and factions
数值控制边界: Define basic courses|periodic assessments|faction organizations; later chapters must pay off classroom knowledge.
与剧情交互方式: Drives rankings, resource distribution, peer relationships, and staged trials.

关键词: Time loops|reset narratives|reset points|escaping loops
意图与同义词: Designing time loops|Writing loop rules|Choosing reset points
大模型指令: Define triggers, reset points, retained memory, escape conditions, and costs together; do not rescue the premise with ad hoc patches.
核心摘要: Clear triggers, resets, memory rules, and exits sustain suspense, especially when costs are explicit.
详细展开: Each loop should change variables and increase fatigue or sanity loss so experimentation has a cost rather than unlimited reloading.
数值控制边界: Specify trigger|reset time|memory holders|exit conditions|loop costs.
与剧情交互方式: Supports trial-and-error solutions, accumulated information, and urgency near psychological collapse.

关键词: Sect management|guild management|resource management|sect-leader fiction
意图与同义词: Running a sect|Expanding a guild|Allocating resources
大模型指令: Track personnel, wealth, reputation, and external crises together; organizational growth should require tradeoffs.
核心摘要: Personnel, money, and reputation must constrain one another so crises force real decisions.
详细展开: Depleted mines, departing disciples, and rival recruitment require reallocation and give management tension.
数值控制边界: Track at least personnel|wealth|reputation; expansion must consume resources and attract external pressure.
与剧情交互方式: Drives management decisions, faction competition, member development, and staged expansion.

关键词: Infinite-world fiction|overlord missions|main and side objectives|mission traps
意图与同义词: Writing mission orders|Designing infinite-world tasks|Making mission mechanics deceptive
大模型指令: Define main objectives, side tasks, penalties, and wording ambiguities; missions may deceive protagonists but not cheat readers.
核心摘要: A strong mission combines survival, tempting extra rewards, and failure costs so choosing becomes the story.
详细展开: Allow bounded textual ambiguity that invites deduction, not arbitrary authorial reinterpretation of difficulty.
数值控制边界: Specify main goal|optional tasks|failure penalty|boundaries of hidden traps.
与剧情交互方式: Drives scenario progression, team roles, and risky reward choices.

关键词: Skill cooldowns|resource cycles|ability rotations|burst and filler
意图与同义词: Designing ability rotations|Balancing cooldowns|Balancing mana consumption
大模型指令: Design burst, filler, and sustain separately, with both cooldowns and resources limiting burst frequency.
核心摘要: These three action classes give combat rhythm rather than endless ability spam.
详细展开: Long-cooldown high-impact abilities create climaxes, cheap short-cooldown skills bridge gaps, and mana or stamina recovery resets the tempo.
数值控制边界: Distinguish burst|filler|sustain; cooldowns and resource expenditure must counterbalance each other.
与剧情交互方式: Structures combat tension, class differences, and the protagonist's growing technical ceiling.

关键词: Gacha systems|pity mechanics|probability design|luck extremes
意图与同义词: Designing gacha|Writing guaranteed pulls|Using lucky and unlucky characters
大模型指令: Make probability, pity, currency sources, and emotional feedback cohere; a golden flash is not a complete mechanic.
核心摘要: Appeal comes from rare surprises, guaranteed fallback rewards, and visual feedback, not merely announcing a rare drop.
详细展开: Control rhythm with pity counts, off-banner results, and scarce currency; extreme luck or misfortune can also reveal character.
数值控制边界: Specify probability ranges|pity count|currency production|off-banner and limited-banner rules.
与剧情交互方式: Creates collecting desire, resource anxiety, and strong emotions at each draw.

关键词: Resident mentor|artifact-spirit teacher|system personality|sarcastic mentor
意图与同义词: Writing an ancient mentor|Characterizing artifact spirits|Giving a system personality
大模型指令: Give the companion mentor independent quirks, goals, and shared interests; do not summon them only to explain lore.
核心摘要: A mentor advantage needs a distinct personality and self-interested goals to avoid becoming an information dispenser.
详细展开: Temperament, teaching methods, and obsession with resurrection shape the protagonist and create both help and conflict.
数值控制边界: Specify origins|quirks|teaching method|personal goals; limit knowledge and direct interventions.
与剧情交互方式: Supports instruction, banter, generational conflict, and cooperation bound by mutual interests.

关键词: System penalties|mission failure|public humiliation|comic missions
意图与同义词: Writing failure penalties|Forcing protagonist action|Designing embarrassing missions
大模型指令: Match penalties to tasks, using embarrassment, loss, or image reversal rather than constant threats of erasure.
核心摘要: In light comedy and urban system fiction, social embarrassment and material loss provide both pressure and humor.
详细展开: Make costs concrete, such as public disgrace, lost assets, or altered appearance, while respecting the story's tolerable limits.
数值控制边界: Specify duration|scope|tolerable limits; penalties cannot repeatedly be severe enough to destroy the main plot.
与剧情交互方式: Forces action, creates countdown urgency, and generates mission comedy.

关键词: Starter packs|opening rewards|first-draw payoff|overpowered openings
意图与同义词: Writing starter rewards|Giving opening bonuses|Establishing the first payoff
大模型指令: Make the opening reward visibly superior while leaving growth potential and later opportunities to prove it.
核心摘要: Starter packs deliver the first major system-fiction payoff by combining immediate excess power with future potential.
详细展开: Pair an immediately useful strong reward with a hidden reward whose full value emerges later, preserving room to grow.
数值控制边界: Distinguish immediate combat gains from long-term growth; an overpowered opening must not foreclose advancement.
与剧情交互方式: Establishes advantage, reader expectations, and the early progression route.

关键词: Currency systems|credit money|counterfeiting prevention|market prosperity
意图与同义词: Building currency systems|Writing money in farming fiction|Establishing trust
大模型指令: Establish trust, backing, and anticounterfeiting before prosperity; the whole world should not accept money on the protagonist's word.
核心摘要: Currency depends on credibility, counterfeit resistance, and redistribution through circulation, not minting alone.
详细展开: Moving from barter to commodity money to credit money requires solving trust, inflation, and forgery at each step.
数值控制边界: Specify backing|issuer|anticounterfeiting|inflation risk; circulation must match productive capacity.
与剧情交互方式: Drives trade growth, wealth transfers, merchant migration, and changes in power.

关键词: MacGuffins|central objects|treasure objectives|universally sought prizes
意图与同义词: Designing a MacGuffin|Defining central objects|Writing adventure objectives
大模型指令: The object's precise function may remain vague, but every faction needs a strong motive to seek it; symbolism matters more than a manual.
核心摘要: A MacGuffin drives events by mobilizing everyone, not through technical specifications.
详细展开: An ordinary-looking object tied to kingship, immortality, or legitimacy links pursuits, betrayals, and factional conflict.
数值控制边界: Specify symbolic value|each faction's motive|authenticity risks|usage threshold; possessing it cannot grant instant omniscience and omnipotence.
与剧情交互方式: Drives treasure hunts, power collisions, and temporary alliances or betrayals.

关键词: Fantasy geography|abnormal climate|ecological adaptation|landscape wonders
意图与同义词: Designing fantastic geography|Integrating abnormal climates|Making floating islands coherent
大模型指令: Give extraordinary environments survival logic, resources, and civilizational adaptations rather than only attractive concept art.
核心摘要: Geography and climate become usable worldbuilding when bound to resources, danger, and residents' lifestyles.
详细展开: Floating islands, underground seas, and crystal forests need transport, agriculture, disaster prevention, and local industries.
数值控制边界: Specify environmental anomaly|key resources|main dangers|resident adaptations.
与剧情交互方式: Creates fresh maps, resource contests, environmental crises, and conflicts between civilizations.

关键词: Inflation|purchasing-power anchors|economic fluctuations|otherworld economies
意图与同义词: Writing fantasy economies|Designing inflation|Preserving purchasing-power coherence
大模型指令: Set basic purchasing-power anchors before market shocks and arbitrage; escalating money figures must have consequences.
核心摘要: Stable economies need fixed reference purchases before wars, discovered mines, or dungeon gold disrupt markets.
详细展开: Prices for bread, medicine, and an inn night establish scale; without them, later wealth and poverty lose meaning.
数值控制边界: Specify basic purchases|currency conversions|sources of market shocks|limits on protagonist arbitrage.
与剧情交互方式: Creates windfalls, shortages, commercial opportunities, and lasting economic pressure.

关键词: Mythology|ancient legends|prophecy|creation myths
意图与同义词: Building mythic history|Integrating prophecy|Creating origin legends
大模型指令: Give myths style and connections to current conflict or future events instead of decorative murals unrelated to the plot.
核心摘要: Myths and prophecies add historical depth while supplying present-day symbols and foreshadowing.
详细展开: Divine roles, symbols, creation stories, and prophetic milestones should echo current factions, forbidden lands, or the protagonist's fate.
数值控制边界: Specify creation narrative|principal gods or symbols|prophecy triggers|reflections in the present world.
与剧情交互方式: Sets up ancient conflicts, religious politics, and a sense of destiny around key events.

关键词: Battle-royale maps|shrinking danger zones|airdrops|last-survivor mechanics
意图与同义词: Designing battle royale|Building survival maps|Writing zone rules
大模型指令: Link maps, shrinking areas, resource respawns, and random events into persistent pressure that prevents safe inactivity.
核心摘要: Compress choices continually while airdrops, bombardment areas, and terrain differences create temporary hotspots.
详细展开: Define shrink timing, initial population, drops, and special rules before the scenario becomes aimless travel.
数值控制边界: Specify participant count|shrink frequency|resource distribution|random events|victory conditions.
与剧情交互方式: Drives movement, alliances, betrayal, and the final shrinking-zone battle.

关键词: Dungeon maps|scenario nodes|hidden rooms|branching routes
意图与同义词: Mapping dungeons|Arranging scenario routes|Designing mazes
大模型指令: Include a main route, branches, mandatory challenges, and concealed rewards so exploration comes from decisions rather than wandering.
核心摘要: Exits, optional treasure, traps, and loops make dungeons more engaging than uninterrupted corridors.
详细展开: Keep a traversable start-to-finish route, ideally through monster or mechanism nodes, with extra rewards for risky branches.
数值控制边界: Specify start and finish|mandatory challenges|branch rewards|hidden rooms|backtracking limits.
与剧情交互方式: Supports exploration choices, resource allocation, and team conflict over routes.

关键词: Random affixes|equipment effects|prefixes and suffixes|legendary gear
意图与同义词: Designing random modifiers|Writing equipment effects|Combining affixes
大模型指令: Separate base stats, prefixes and suffixes, and unique effects; adjectives alone cannot establish rarity or power.
核心摘要: Readers should immediately distinguish base values, affix bonuses, and unique effects.
详细展开: Prefixes often emphasize attack direction, suffixes supplement basic stats, and legendary modifiers change playstyle; layered structure makes upgrades understandable.
数值控制边界: Distinguish base attributes|prefixes|suffixes|unique effects; rarity must match drop rates and progression stage.
与剧情交互方式: Creates loot satisfaction, build diversity, and equipment progression.

关键词: Dream mazes|subconscious spaces|embodied trauma|dream rules
意图与同义词: Designing dream labyrinths|Writing subconscious settings|Externalizing trauma
大模型指令: Give each dream layer a psychological theme and physical anomaly; the core must confront trauma rather than only offer beautiful strange scenery.
核心摘要: Broken spatial logic mapped to trauma turns inner problems into an explorable, contestable landscape.
详细展开: Use mild distortions near the surface, collapsing laws deeper down, and symbols or shadow selves at the core to force confrontation.
数值控制边界: Specify layers|each layer's rules|trauma symbols|escape conditions; anomalies must serve the character arc.
与剧情交互方式: Reveals wounds, enables psychological breakthroughs, and supports surreal exploration.

关键词: Time paradoxes|time travel|self-consistency|temporal correction
意图与同义词: Handling paradoxes|Making time travel coherent|Solving the grandfather paradox
大模型指令: Choose a single universe, multiverse, or self-consistent loop first, then apply one consequence model to every paradox.
核心摘要: Do not rewrite temporal rules on demand; determine how the universe handles paradoxes and remain consistent.
详细展开: A self-correcting universe needs reactions such as jammed guns or temporal shadows; branching worlds require accepting split timelines and their costs.
数值控制边界: Specify universe model|paradox consequences|correction method|costs; do not mix incompatible rules within one work.
与剧情交互方式: Supports time-travel plots, causal backlash, and limits on historical changes.

关键词: Bureaucratic systems|noble ranks|promotion paths|powers and duties
意图与同义词: Building official hierarchies|Designing nobility|Writing promotion routes
大模型指令: Pair each rank with powers, responsibilities, and entry thresholds so titles change the protagonist's resources and risks.
核心摘要: Meaningful advancement changes tax authority, military command, obligations, and hostility rather than only honorifics.
详细展开: Military merit, examinations, patronage, and wartime appointments can all provide advancement, each with different factional commitments and liabilities.
数值控制边界: Specify ranks|powers and duties|promotion channels|resource and risk effects.
与剧情交互方式: Supports court advancement, military honors, aristocratic suppression, and institutional conflict.

关键词: Black markets|contraband|risk pricing|underground trade
意图与同义词: Designing black markets|Writing contraband commerce|Giving illicit trade a forbidden atmosphere
大模型指令: Give goods risk labels and compromised origins; price them through danger, scarcity, and investigative pressure.
核心摘要: The attraction is not merely prohibition: pursuit, curses, or exposure make buying a consequential choice.
详细展开: Stolen goods, cursed objects, military chips, and slave contracts can appear in fictional inventories; explain why lawful channels lack them and whose attention they attract.
数值控制边界: Specify goods|risk sources|pricing rationale|trade rules|consequences of investigation.
与剧情交互方式: Creates underground atmosphere, tempting resources, and cascading pressure from authorities or powerful factions.

关键词: Low-tech industry|technology-tree progression|glass soap and gunpowder|transmigration technology
意图与同义词: Advancing technology after transmigration|Writing primitive glassmaking|Ordering infrastructure upgrades
大模型指令: Establish material substitutes, temperature requirements, and process barriers before astonished reactions; modern manufacturing is not a spell.
核心摘要: Credible technological uplift depends on substitutions and costly experiments, not instant industrialization at a word.
详细展开: Seaweed ash instead of soda ash, earthen kilns instead of blast furnaces, and crude tools instead of precision equipment illustrate the adaptation process that gives technical fiction its payoff.
数值控制边界: Specify material substitutions|process obstacles|trial costs|production limits; no overnight industrial revolution.
与剧情交互方式: Supports infrastructure, accumulating wealth, civilizational change, and reactions from established powers.

关键词: Dark forest|cosmic silence|Fermi paradox|interstellar fear
意图与同义词: Explaining cosmic silence|Varying dark-forest premises|Why signals are dangerous
大模型指令: Choose the reason for silence, then let a small protagonist action trigger interstellar consequences; fear should arise from rules, not a single attack.
核心摘要: Cosmic silence becomes frightening when it is itself a lethal operating rule.
详细展开: A Great Filter, observer civilization, or berserker probes can explain silence; once selected, all civilizations' behavior must respond coherently.
数值控制边界: Specify cause of silence|detection and exposure rules|cascading consequences of protagonist actions.
与剧情交互方式: Builds hard-science suspense, civilizational dread, and disaster chains after accidental transmissions.

关键词: Ability adaptation|cross-world powers|stylistic unity|fan-fiction transformation
意图与同义词: Adapting abilities to a new world|Reworking cross-world powers|Integrating fan-fiction power systems
大模型指令: Keep an ability's essence but rewrite its expression and counters through the destination world's rules.
核心摘要: Successful adaptation preserves identity while changing mechanics so the character belongs in the new world rather than carrying pasted-on lore.
详细展开: Electrical power might become biological hacking, electromagnetic machinery, or law-governed lightning; its carrier and weaknesses must change with the setting.
数值控制边界: Specify retained traits|new expression|nerfs and improvements|local counters.
与剧情交互方式: Solves stylistic and balance conflicts in crossover, fan-fiction, and multiverse stories.

关键词: Anomaly containment|SCP|containment classes|experiment logs
意图与同义词: Writing containment systems|Classifying anomalies|Building SCP-like settings
大模型指令: Use consistent classification, containment, and test consequences so the organization behaves systematically rather than improvisationally.
核心摘要: Credibility comes from classification criteria, fixed reporting formats, and calm records of failure.
详细展开: Safe, Euclid, and Keter are only labels; define the risk, resources, and discipline each classification actually entails.
数值控制边界: Specify classification criteria|containment procedures|experiment permissions|breach consequences|report format.
与剧情交互方式: Supports institutional power, experimental tragedies, and escalating pressure from anomalous objects.

关键词: Monster cuisine|dungeon food|ingredient preparation|food buffs
意图与同义词: Designing monster dishes|Writing dungeon recipes|Effects of eating monsters
大模型指令: Describe fictional detoxification and preparation before flavor analogies and temporary effects, combining novelty with utility.
核心摘要: The appeal lies in transforming dangerous creatures into edible, useful food rather than novelty ingredients alone.
详细展开: Removing poison sacs, drying, blanching in holy water, and granting brief buffs make cuisine part of adventuring life rather than a gimmick.
数值控制边界: Specify preparation|toxicity risks|flavor comparisons|buff duration and strength.
与剧情交互方式: Enriches adventure routines, resource cycles, lightheartedness, and ecological information.

关键词: Neutral zones|sanctuaries|peace hotels|underworld rules
意图与同义词: Designing neutral zones|Writing peace-hotel rules|Building assassin sanctuaries
大模型指令: Give neutral territory absolute rules, enforcement costs, and a symbolic space that makes dangerous people temporarily behave.
核心摘要: The attraction is placing lethal people under one roof while enforced rules hold down the tension.
详细展开: Peace hotels, underground clinics, and assassin inns work if readers know who maintains order and the severity of breaches.
数值控制边界: Specify prohibitions|enforcers|punishments|why all factions accept the arrangement.
与剧情交互方式: Allows multiparty meetings, information exchange, truces, and major chain reactions when rules break.

关键词: Class mobility|social mobility|advancement channels|identity transitions
意图与同义词: Designing social classes|Writing mobility|Making underdog ascent plausible
大模型指令: Define upward paths and costs before deciding why some rise and most cannot.
核心摘要: Ambition, envy, and reversals gain weight when class boundaries can move or remain locked.
详细展开: Military merit, examinations, sect tests, and business success need thresholds, costs, and obstruction from incumbents.
数值控制边界: Specify advancement paths|required resources|failure costs|elite gatekeeping.
与剧情交互方式: Explains the protagonist's opportunity, antagonists' gatekeeping, and escalating class conflict.

关键词: Supernatural law|superpower regulation|cultivator statutes|special laws
意图与同义词: Regulating superhumans|Writing laws for powers|Handling cultivator crime
大模型指令: Design jurisdiction, enforcement, and exemptions for extraordinary people; powers cannot affect only combat and leave law untouched.
核心摘要: A world with flight, extraordinary killing, and memory alteration cannot convincingly retain unchanged real-world law.
详细展开: Registration, licensing, special courts, overreach penalties, and compensation for power accidents make society function.
数值控制边界: Specify jurisdiction|covered persons|exemptions|consequences of overstepping.
与剧情交互方式: Creates institutional conflict, pursuit procedures, gray areas, and obstacles or loopholes for protagonists.

关键词: Trade networks|resource nodes|trade routes|goods circulation|supply chains
意图与同义词: Writing economic networks|Designing trade routes|Moving resources
大模型指令: Show transport, monopolies, smuggling, and pricing as well as origins; circulation itself creates conflict.
核心摘要: Resources become dramatic through the hands they pass between source and consumer, not just labels on maps.
详细展开: Mines, medicinal plants, grain, and chips can be nodes; a broken route often triggers more action than the resource itself.
数值控制边界: Specify core resources|main origins|transport risks|controlling factions.
与剧情交互方式: Creates route seizures, blockades, smuggling, inflation, and openings in supply chains.

关键词: Transport networks|danger zones|navigation routes|border passages|travel costs
意图与同义词: Connecting maps|Designing transport|Effects of dangerous regions
大模型指令: Bind travel modes and hazards to map structure so journeys influence economics and war rather than merely move characters.
核心摘要: Real travel costs and dangerous belts make the world's scale tangible and distant places truly remote.
详细展开: Airship routes, mountain passes, wormholes, straits, and monster forests determine arrival, blockades, and detours.
数值控制边界: Specify routes|conditions that block them|controllers|passage costs.
与剧情交互方式: Supports chases, closed borders, supply shortages, new-volume settings, and geopolitical maneuvering.

关键词: Historical events|old-war trauma|turning points|dynastic succession|historical scars
意图与同义词: Making history affect the present|Giving events lasting effects|Writing war trauma
大模型指令: Do not stop at a timeline; identify old events that still determine hatred, fear, and alliances.
核心摘要: Weighty history presses past wounds and inherited order onto present characters.
详细展开: Fallen nations, forbidden-magic wars, divine disasters, and dynastic purges can generate current laws, grudges, and taboos.
数值控制边界: Specify pivotal events|affected groups|remaining taboos|present consequences.
与剧情交互方式: Explains factional hatred, institutions, ruin value, and family burdens.

关键词: Cultural traditions|taboo rituals|festivals|religious customs|folklore
意图与同义词: Designing culture|Writing ritual atmosphere|Integrating taboos
大模型指令: Make festivals, customs, and prohibitions rules that shape choices rather than inert background.
核心摘要: Tradition matters when characters must obey, violate, or exploit it, not when it exists only in a setting document.
详细展开: Coming-of-age rites, night-vigil festivals, soul-sending ceremonies, and ancestral prohibitions can become plot nodes and emotional amplifiers.
数值控制边界: Specify participants|triggering occasions|prohibitions|cost of violation.
与剧情交互方式: Supports festival scenes, factional differences, taboo conflicts, and cultural misjudgments.

关键词: Education systems|transmission of knowledge|apprenticeship|academy selection|knowledge monopolies
意图与同义词: Passing down power|Selecting students|Making sect recruitment logical
大模型指令: Specify who may learn, who selects them, and who is excluded; education is a power structure.
核心摘要: Training systems determine how elites are made and what ordinary people must pay to approach core knowledge.
详细展开: Examinations, mentorship, bloodline barriers, memory implantation, and tuition debt can all act as filters.
数值控制边界: Specify entry thresholds|elimination mechanisms|elite paths|resource sources.
与剧情交互方式: Supports enrollment, apprenticeships, knowledge monopolies, class division, and exceptional promotions.

关键词: Conflict sources|internal and external tensions|resource contests|ideological clashes|power struggles
意图与同义词: Building world conflicts|Sources of tension|Keeping a world dramatic
大模型指令: Design resource, ideological, political, and external-threat conflicts together rather than sustaining the world with one villain.
核心摘要: A durable long-form setting needs an interacting web of conflicts, not one thread.
详细展开: Shortages create class tensions, ideological differences redraw factions, and external enemies may force temporary alliances.
数值控制边界: Specify at least three internal conflict types|one external threat|affected populations.
与剧情交互方式: Continually supplies side plots, volume crises, shifting allegiances, and ruptured relationships.

关键词: Acquiring special powers|origins of advantages|awakening|inherited systems|gaining abilities
意图与同义词: How to acquire an advantage|Designing power origins|Why the protagonist receives power
大模型指令: Choose the source and acquisition conditions before explaining why the protagonist receives it; avoid unexplained gifts from nowhere.
核心摘要: Acquisition determines whether power feels destined or accidental and whether others will covet it.
详细展开: Awakening, inheritance, trade, lucky discoveries, binding, or sacrificial exchange can work; clear origins strengthen later logic.
数值控制边界: Specify origin type|initial conditions|protagonist's distinguishing trait|risk of losing the power.
与剧情交互方式: Builds opening hooks, rivals, destiny foreshadowing, and ownership conflicts.

关键词: First power appearance|initial reveal|debut|opening ability display|first payoff
意图与同义词: Introducing a special power|Showing an advantage at the opening|Making the first display compelling
大模型指令: Show a payoff while planting limitations and a larger mystery, not merely spectacle.
核心摘要: The debut defines whether readers see a cheat, costly weapon, or dangerous gift not yet understood.
详细展开: Deliver a small immediate reversal, then reveal one unexplained cost or rule.
数值控制边界: Specify first effect|witness reactions|hidden information|later restrictions.
与剧情交互方式: Hooks the opening, establishes understanding, and introduces investigators or upgrade expectations.

关键词: Growth milestones|ability unlocks|story stages|upgrade pacing|staged improvements
意图与同义词: Upgrading powers in stages|Timing ability unlocks|Matching growth to the plot
大模型指令: Tie unlocks to story stages and personal costs rather than numbers alone.
核心摘要: Aligned growth makes every unlock feel like opening a new narrative door.
详细展开: New maps, opponents, truths, or costs can become thresholds that interlock growth and story.
设定类型: Growth milestones mapped to story stages
数值控制边界: Specify number of stages|unlock conditions|new ability types|narrative function.
与剧情交互方式: Structures climaxes, growth turns, and control of power inflation.

关键词: Limitation design|cooldowns|usage caps|side effects|conditional thresholds
意图与同义词: Limiting cheats|Designing ability costs|Preventing power collapse
大模型指令: Combine time, frequency, cost, and situational restrictions so strength never permits thoughtless use.
核心摘要: Single restrictions invite easy loopholes; combinations resemble realistic risk systems.
详细展开: Cooldowns limit frequency, usage caps preserve preciousness, side effects create pain, and situational thresholds encourage strategy.
数值控制边界: Specify at least two limit types|triggers|avoidance methods|breach consequences.
与剧情交互方式: Creates tradeoffs and tactical thinking while preventing one-button victories.

关键词: Rule chains|closed rule systems|scenario truth|rule progression|horror structure
意图与同义词: Closing a rule system|Building rule chains|Resolving scenario truths
大模型指令: Link surface rules, contradictions, and final truth in a progression toward one central explanation.
核心摘要: A closed chain prevents strange clauses from becoming disconnected scares.
详细展开: Initial rules enable survival, middle rules provoke doubt, and final rules explain the order's origin, rewarding rereading.
数值控制边界: Specify opening rules|middle contradictions|hidden rules|final truth.
与剧情交互方式: Supports book- or volume-scale scenarios where deduction and horror converge on one answer.

关键词: True and false rules|surface rules|hidden rules|incorrect rules|rule layers
意图与同义词: Layering true and false rules|Designing false rules|Making room for deduction
大模型指令: Separate surface, contradictory, hidden, and false layers so readers can survive while continuing to question.
核心摘要: Layering combines executable rules with interpretive space and reversals.
详细展开: Surface rules preserve life, contradictions create doubt, hidden rules reveal truth, and false rules lure victims or mislead.
数值控制边界: Specify each layer's function|recognition clues|violation consequences|final relationships.
与剧情交互方式: Supports experimentation, reader deduction, and chapter-level reversals of understanding.

关键词: Talent ranks|SSS talents|upgrade mechanics|resonance|talent systems
意图与同义词: Designing talents|Balancing SSS rank|Upgrading talents
大模型指令: Bind rarity, growth, and limits; stronger top-tier talents need clearer usage boundaries and acquisition barriers.
核心摘要: Appeal comes from knowing a talent is strong, rare, and expandable but never free.
详细展开: Design ranks, conditions, materials, synergies, and breakthrough methods together for both satisfaction and longevity.
数值控制边界: Specify rarity tiers|upgrade path|usage limits|combination effects.
与剧情交互方式: Maintains growth expectations, rewards milestones, and supports complementary teams.

关键词: Scenario design|mission objectives|rewards|time limits|side quests
意图与同义词: Designing complete scenarios|Matching rewards to missions|Establishing timed scenarios
大模型指令: Provide goals, deadlines, rules, and a reward loop so characters know why to risk themselves and why they cannot delay.
核心摘要: Goals, danger, time pressure, and returns must form one forward-driving loop.
详细展开: Main missions enable clearance, side tasks tempt risks, hidden rewards encourage exploration, and countdowns tighten everything.
数值控制边界: Specify main task|optional tasks|failure conditions|reward tiers.
与剧情交互方式: Supports challenge progression, ratings, hidden routes, and resource acquisition logic.

关键词: Rule validation|edge cases|coverage|logical consistency|loopholes
意图与同义词: Checking rules|Finding loopholes|Preventing contradictory lore
大模型指令: Cross-check characters, settings, time, and behavior before major loopholes emerge late in drafting.
核心摘要: Validation is the final safeguard against self-contradictory premises.
详细展开: Check who is bound, where rules apply, when exceptions occur, and how borderline actions are judged.
数值控制边界: Check character|setting|time|behavior edge cases.
与剧情交互方式: Finds contradictions early so later deductions, conflicts, and escape routes hold up.

关键词: Branch flags|attribute thresholds|hidden choices|route variables|plot branches
意图与同义词: Recording branches|Triggering hidden choices|Designing stat thresholds
大模型指令: Give important choices traceable flags and thresholds so their effects persist.
核心摘要: Branches matter when they later change destiny, not merely substitute an immediate reply.
详细展开: Loyalty, intelligence requirements, hidden items, and route markers can trigger branches but must receive payoffs.
数值控制边界: Specify trigger variables|recording method|payoff points|substantive consequences.
与剧情交互方式: Supports multiple endings, hidden routes, true-ending conditions, and exploration satisfaction.

关键词: Exposure score|pursuit risk|revealed abilities|higher-power attention|tracking
意图与同义词: Being targeted after using powers|Designing exposure risks|Making use increasingly dangerous
大模型指令: Make exposure cumulative; conspicuous use must invite later pursuit or scrutiny.
核心摘要: The more useful a powerful ability is, the more exposure can force tradeoffs between satisfaction and danger.
详细展开: Higher beings, hostile organizations, state agencies, or peers may notice; every use should leave traces.
数值控制边界: Specify exposure sources|accumulation|thresholds|discoverers|consequence levels.
与剧情交互方式: Limits use frequency, raises costs, and creates middle- and late-story pursuit pressure.

关键词: Exchange currency|overlord hub|shop economy|resource settlement|trade systems
意图与同义词: Trading in mission hubs|Designing currencies|Balancing system stores
大模型指令: Design income, prices, scarcity, and discounted buybacks together; stores cannot be infinite cash machines.
核心摘要: A coherent exchange economy creates tension in rewards, resource choices, and team trades.
详细展开: Basic money supports survival, rare tokens enable major jumps, and caps or resale losses prevent unlimited farming.
数值控制边界: Specify currency sources|ordinary prices|rare tokens|purchase caps|buyback losses.
与剧情交互方式: Drives reward choices, team splits, stockpiling, and mid-story financial pressure.

关键词: Talent resonance|counter chains|talent combinations|compatibility|ability interaction
意图与同义词: Combining talents|Countering powers|Designing affinities
大模型指令: Design synergies and counters alongside individual strength so team composition and situational judgment matter.
核心摘要: Resonance and counter chains shift competition from raw stats to configuration and reading the encounter.
详细展开: Perception can synergize with recording, purification counter corruption, and rule exemptions counter control; clear relationships sustain stories.
数值控制边界: Specify key combinations|basic counters|stacking caps|countermeasures.
与剧情交互方式: Supports complementary teams, tactical contests, upgrade anticipation, and scenario-solving combinations.

关键词: Higher-dimensional hierarchy|rule makers|enforcers|agents|world order
意图与同义词: Who writes the rules|Ranking higher beings|Building hidden order
大模型指令: Separate rule makers, enforcement powers, and local agents rather than attributing every anomaly to one omnipotent mastermind.
核心摘要: Clear levels stabilize the world's pressure and explanatory logic while giving each level a narrative role.
详细展开: Makers supply purpose, enforcers maintain order, and agents manifest within scenarios, creating stages for revelation.
数值控制边界: Specify three functional levels|interaction boundaries|manifestation methods|information visibility.
与剧情交互方式: Supports hidden truths, gradual revelation, unequal permissions, and distinct sources of pressure.

关键词: Reality linkage|scenario-failure consequences|disaster mechanics|clearance blessings|world feedback
意图与同义词: Linking scenarios to reality|Designing failure consequences|Making rewards affect reality
大模型指令: Let results alter real resources, public opinion, order, or disaster severity rather than treating reality as a backdrop.
核心摘要: Tight linkage gives each choice credible national or societal weight.
详细展开: Failure may pollute regions, destroy infrastructure, or kill populations; success may bring cleansing, resources, technology, or morale.
数值控制边界: Specify failure consequences|success benefits|scope|duration|reversibility.
与剧情交互方式: Creates large-scale stakes, real-world pressure, and political or social reactions beyond scenarios.

关键词: Settlement ratings|scoring systems|hidden scores|score weights|clearance grades
意图与同义词: Scoring scenarios|Connecting grades and rewards|Designing hidden scores
大模型指令: Reveal some score criteria and hide others so routes can be optimized without exhausting exploration.
核心摘要: Scoring explains why characters risk side tasks and more dangerous completion methods; it is not decorative.
详细展开: Survival, efficiency, rescues, rule comprehension, pollution control, and hidden objectives can score, but weights need advance hints.
数值控制边界: Specify base criteria|hidden bonuses|grade bands|reward gaps|score display.
与剧情交互方式: Differentiates returns, guides exploration, and supports true-ending or hidden-route rewards.

关键词: Accumulating corruption|sanity|lasting symptoms|recovery windows|purification
意图与同义词: Designing corruption scores|Recovering sanity|Writing aftereffects and rest periods
大模型指令: Track both corruption and recovery; avoid instant ruin from one touch or complete reset after sleep.
核心摘要: Survivors should retain wounds, extending scenario pressure into life outside.
详细展开: Progress from mild symptoms to partial loss of control and severe transformation; recovery may require time, medicine, rituals, care, or special locations.
数值控制边界: Specify sources|graded symptoms|recovery methods|recovery limits|irreversible effects.
与剧情交互方式: Maintains pressure, creates rest-period plots, and raises key ability costs.

关键词: Staged unlocks|growth phases|activating functions|chapter permissions|ability trees
意图与同义词: Unlocking powers gradually|Timing new abilities|Avoiding instant full capability
大模型指令: Divide powers into stages tied to costs, conditions, and narrative responsibilities.
核心摘要: Staged unlocks preserve long-term anticipation without flattening early conflict.
详细展开: Early power protects life, middle power breaks deadlocks, and late power rewrites rules; costs and exposure must grow alongside strength.
数值控制边界: Specify stage count|functions per stage|unlock conditions|new costs|main-plot links.
与剧情交互方式: Plans long-term progression, stage climaxes, and parallel growth of power and responsibility.

关键词: Cooldown restrictions|usage counts|resource costs|cheat boundaries|ability balance
意图与同义词: Limiting excessive powers|Preventing omnipotent systems|Giving advantages boundaries
适用题材: 玄幻|都市|科幻|悬疑|游戏
大模型指令: Assign each strong ability cooldowns, usage caps, costs, or situational gates so the protagonist must judge when it is worthwhile.
核心摘要: The stronger the advantage, the more traceable its limits must be to avoid becoming a universal key.
详细展开: Time, stamina, spiritual energy, points, intelligence, permissions, or environment can constrain use; readers should understand the limits in advance.
数值控制边界: Specify cooldown|usage count|resources consumed|failure consequences|avoidance conditions.
与剧情交互方式: Creates pivotal choices, preserves danger, and prevents powers from flattening conflict.

关键词: Physical costs|mental costs|social costs|external costs|double-edged power
意图与同义词: Types of ability costs|Designing forbidden-technique costs|Layering consequences
大模型指令: Separate bodily, psychological, relational, and external-world costs instead of merely saying the character becomes weak.
核心摘要: Concrete costs let readers feel excitement and worry together, making power believable.
详细展开: Bodily costs hurt immediately, mental costs erode over time, social costs expose secrets, and external costs attract stronger enemies.
数值控制边界: Specify immediate cost|delayed cost|recoverable portion|irreversible risk|who notices.
与剧情交互方式: Supports forbidden bursts, survival powers, exposed secrets, and later pursuit.

关键词: First reveal|ability debut|opening three chapters|selling-point display|first payoff
意图与同义词: Introducing a special power|Making its debut gripping|Showing powers early
大模型指令: Show only the ability that best embodies the premise, not the whole instruction manual.
核心摘要: A debut should reveal why the book is engaging, not explain every rule.
详细展开: Tie the first use to a real crisis, saving a life, humiliating an opponent, breaking a deadlock, or reversing emotion while leaving unlock potential.
数值控制边界: Specify crisis|displayed ability|visible gain|unexplained mystery|upgrade opening.
与剧情交互方式: Delivers the premise in the opening three chapters and establishes initial expectations.

关键词: Hidden mechanisms|long-term side effects|usage records|tracking|secret exposure
意图与同义词: Planting hidden power rules|Writing aftereffects|Can the advantage be discovered
大模型指令: Give powers partially undisclosed mechanics so each use may leave traces that matter later.
核心摘要: Hidden mechanics turn an immediate solution into long-term foreshadowing.
详细展开: Usage records, energy residue, dream contamination, system logs, others' perception, and fate shifts can all support later investigations.
数值控制边界: Specify hidden rule|trigger signs|possible observers|payoff window|loss-of-control risk.
与剧情交互方式: Plants prolonged tracking, identity crises, and truths about the power's origin.

关键词: Identifying false rules|rules-horror talents|rule hints|incorrect rules|rule appraisal
意图与同义词: Designing rules-horror powers|Detecting false rules|Avoiding overpowered hints
大模型指令: Provide grounds for judgment or risk warnings rather than feeding the correct answer directly.
核心摘要: The payoff is narrowing mistakes, not replacing the protagonist's reasoning.
详细展开: Colors, dissonance markers, danger ratings, cost warnings, or highlighted keywords can hint, but require uncertainty and usage costs.
数值控制边界: Specify detectable objects|error probability|usage cost|cooldown|undetectable levels.
与剧情交互方式: Supports deduction, escape-route judgments, and choices under pressure.

关键词: Rule loopholes|permission exploitation|exceptions|rule boundaries|mechanic exploits
意图与同义词: Designing loopholes|Winning through rules|Exploiting scenario mechanics
大模型指令: Derive loopholes from established boundaries, exceptions, or differing subjects, not last-minute authorial escape hatches.
核心摘要: Satisfaction comes from understanding the rules better than the scenario, not their sudden disappearance.
详细展开: Time, identity, location, action definitions, reward conditions, and penalty targets offer risky but logical boundaries.
数值控制边界: Specify original rule|exploitable boundary|failure risk|trigger steps|scenario countermeasures.
与剧情交互方式: Supports tactical solutions, true-ending routes, and turning mechanics against enemies.

关键词: Management dashboards|inventory ledgers|order systems|manufacturing systems|profit curves
意图与同义词: Writing management powers|Designing farming systems|Making business panels interesting
大模型指令: Turn stock, costs, orders, and reputation into plot pressure rather than numerical recitation.
核心摘要: A management advantage lets readers watch small resources accumulate into a larger enterprise.
详细展开: Panels may show inventory, profit, customer demand, proficiency, and risk, but each expansion must bring relationship, competition, or supply-chain problems.
数值控制边界: Specify resource inputs|cost structure|return cycle|expansion bottlenecks|outside competition.
与剧情交互方式: Supports farming enterprises, period trading, urban startups, and slow accumulation payoffs.

关键词: Pocket-space herb gardens|personal dimensions|spirit springs|preserved storage|planting upgrades
意图与同义词: Writing pocket-space powers|Refreshing garden and spring premises|Limiting personal dimensions
大模型指令: Limit production rate, capacity, and exposure so material problems do not disappear overnight.
核心摘要: The core is steady accumulation, secret management, and resource allocation, not infinite supplies.
详细展开: Land grades, crop cycles, spring consumption, capacity, and concealment constrain output and give harvests a management feel.
数值控制边界: Specify capacity|crop cycles|upgrade conditions|exposure risk|public explanation.
与剧情交互方式: Supports rural prosperity, medicine and herb production, period supplies, and gradual female-oriented progression.

关键词: Past-life memories|information advantage|future milestones|rebirth advantage|correcting regrets
意图与同义词: Balancing rebirth memories|Using past-life information|Limiting future knowledge
大模型指令: Limit memory to important events and personal understanding rather than a complete walkthrough.
核心摘要: The advantage is anticipating trends; the drama is correcting old regrets while handling new variables.
详细展开: Blurred recall, mistakes, and butterfly effects should make memory less reliable as history changes, preserving meaningful choices.
数值控制边界: Specify memory scope|key events|sources of error|variable consequences|emotional regrets.
与剧情交互方式: Supports rebirth revenge, changed period destinies, commercial prediction, and relationship repair.

关键词: Mind reading|affection panels|romance mission systems|emotion scores|relationship progress
意图与同义词: Writing mind-reading powers|Avoiding awkward affection systems|Creating romance-system tension
大模型指令: Provide fragmentary signals so characters must still understand people and act.
核心摘要: Do not turn love into score grinding; preserve misinterpretation, concealment, and real decisions.
详细展开: Scores can show trends and mind reading fragments, but neither replaces communication nor bypasses dignity and boundaries.
数值控制边界: Specify visible information|blind spots|misreading risks|ethical limits|relational backlash.
与剧情交互方式: Supports transmigration romance missions, romantic push-pull, resolving misunderstandings, and emotional contests.

关键词: Period supplies|ration-coupon exchange|supply restrictions|black-market risks|better living
意图与同义词: Writing period-fiction powers|Grounding supply systems|Balancing ration-era advantages
大模型指令: Constrain supplies through coupons, transport, close-knit communities, and policy risks instead of freely importing a modern supermarket.
核心摘要: Filling shortages is satisfying, but every item needs a credible explanation of origin.
详细展开: Grain and cloth coupons, industrial vouchers, cooperatives, black markets, and workplace allocation create risky improvements.
数值控制边界: Specify supply origins|exchange costs|historical restrictions|circulation risks|public account.
与剧情交互方式: Supports period prosperity, improved family life, neighbor conflicts, and realism.

关键词: Quick-transmigration missions|main tasks|side tasks|failure penalties|world settlement
意图与同义词: Designing transmigration systems|Handling mission failure|Writing world settlement
大模型指令: Separate goals, limits, punishments, and settlement so each world has independent pressure.
核心摘要: The appeal lies in different rules forcing different choices, not merely switching worlds.
详细展开: Main missions determine departure, side missions rewards or hidden truths, penalties urgency, and settlement the next world's abilities and debts.
数值控制边界: Specify main goal|side rewards|failure penalties|settlement metrics|cross-world carryovers.
与剧情交互方式: Structures episode pacing, mission pressure, and long-term growth.

关键词: Plot deviation|world collapse|mission warnings|fate-line correction
意图与同义词: Designing deviation scores|Handling broken plots|Writing timeline warnings
大模型指令: Indicate the direction of imbalance without choosing the right answer for the protagonist.
核心摘要: Deviation creates urgency and strategic pressure by showing the world moving beyond control.
详细展开: Deaths of key people, displaced plot events, unstable targets, or exposed identities increase deviation and the cost of correction.
数值控制边界: Specify deviation sources|warning thresholds|correction methods|correction costs|collapse consequences.
与剧情交互方式: Supports failed missions, hidden-route activation, and timeline instability.

关键词: Original host's obsession|wish lists|soul echoes|repairing regrets
意图与同义词: Designing host obsessions|Writing transmigration wishes|Giving another person's comeback emotion
大模型指令: Ground wishes in specific relationships and regrets, not empty goals such as revenge or strength.
核心摘要: A wish system binds missions to emotional debts instead of mechanical world grinding.
详细展开: Restoring innocence, protecting someone, reclaiming identity, leaving harmful relationships, or saying unspoken words creates a clear emotional core.
数值控制边界: Specify object of obsession|unfinished event|emotional debt|completion standard|residual echo after failure.
与剧情交互方式: Anchors episodes, inhabiting identities, and emotional payoff at settlement.

关键词: Fantasy-romance bloodlines|divine ancestry|half-demon heritage|bloodline awakening|ancestral costs
意图与同义词: Writing fantasy-romance ancestry|Refreshing divine bloodlines|Costs of awakening
大模型指令: Give lineage honor, taboo, and cost rather than only an identity advantage.
核心摘要: Awakening supplies payoff; persecution, rejection, or inherited destiny supplies tension.
详细展开: Use purity, awakening stages, clan taboos, side effects, and exposure risks to control strength.
数值控制边界: Specify ancestry|awakening conditions|ability boundaries|clan relationships|exposure consequences.
与剧情交互方式: Supports identity reversals, forbidden love, intergroup conflict, and growth.

关键词: Contracted spirit beasts|bonded beasts|spirit-pet growth|reciprocal contracts|beast backlash
意图与同义词: Writing beast contracts|Growing spirit pets|Designing contract backlash
大模型指令: Give beasts independent habits and needs instead of making them a mobile ability bar.
核心摘要: A reciprocal bond grants help while imposing feeding, emotional, and backlash obligations.
详细展开: Contracts may share senses, lend abilities, advance together, or synchronize injury, but beasts retain will and ties to their species.
数值控制边界: Specify bonding method|shared abilities|growth resources|backlash risks|termination conditions.
与剧情交互方式: Supports companions, coordinated combat, emotional company, and ecology.

关键词: Merit and fortune|exceptional luck|repaid kindness|luck backlash|blessing limits
意图与同义词: Writing lucky protagonists|Avoiding mindless fortune systems|Designing merit progression
大模型指令: Give good fortune an origin, delayed repayment, and backlash for overuse.
核心摘要: Luck should echo accumulated choices rather than mean finding money at will.
详细展开: Merit, reputation, favors, kindness, and causality can generate luck, but it cannot precisely rescue every crisis.
数值控制边界: Specify fortune sources|trigger probability|repayment delay|overdraft backlash|events beyond intervention.
与剧情交互方式: Supports delayed rewards, farming accumulation, healing-oriented stories, and networks of favors.

关键词: Inherited medicine|medicinal cuisine systems|treatment spaces|healing powers|illness limits
意图与同义词: Writing female-oriented medical powers|Designing medicinal cuisine systems|Balancing healing
适用题材: 古言|现言|年代|种田|幻言
大模型指令: Specify diagnosis, ingredients, treatment time, and risk instead of one needle curing everything.
核心摘要: Healing supports gradual female-oriented growth but must retain illness complexity and thresholds of public trust.
详细展开: Fictional medicinal cuisine, acupuncture, pocket-space herbs, or diagnostic hints create forms; scarce ingredients, patients' identities, and diagnostic errors create conflict.
数值控制边界: Specify treatable conditions|treatment time|ingredient sources|failure risk|patient-trust thresholds.
与剧情交互方式: Supports historical healers, improved period living, herb gardens, and emotional redemption.

关键词: Lightning tribulations|heavenly punishment|karmic debts|ascension trials|inner-demon trials
意图与同义词: Designing tribulations|Making lightning trials logical|Writing inner demons
大模型指令: Let cultivation, karma, and mental state determine trials rather than fixed lightning strikes.
核心摘要: Trials test strength while settling the consequences of past choices.
详细展开: Lightning tests the body, inner demons test attachment, and karmic trials settle debts; combine them as staged growth thresholds.
数值控制边界: Specify triggering realm|trial types|karmic weighting|failure consequences|limits on outside help.
与剧情交互方式: Supports breakthroughs, emotional trials, old debts, and climaxes.

关键词: Secret-realm rules|resource respawns|entry quotas|realm cycles|opportunity risks
意图与同义词: Designing secret realms|Avoiding cultivation clichés|Giving resource contests rules
大模型指令: Define entry, cycles, resource logic, and danger rather than a random treasure-box map.
核心摘要: Scarcity and rules determine value: who enters, what leaves, and what might awaken.
详细展开: Quotas, time limits, flight or killing bans, resource maturation, and guardian ecology form an independent system.
数值控制边界: Specify opening cycle|entry thresholds|resource distribution|taboos|exit conditions.
与剧情交互方式: Supports sect rivalry, teamwork, new-volume settings, and the cost of opportunity.

关键词: Rule contamination|cognitive erosion|altered records|memory errors|scenario aftereffects
意图与同义词: Designing rule contamination|Writing horror aftereffects|Handling altered cognition
大模型指令: Affect memory, perception, and records so horror extends from scenarios into reality.
核心摘要: The pressure comes from uncertainty about whether characters can trust themselves.
详细展开: Changing records, wrong forms of address, unsynchronized shadows, missing memories, or compulsive rule obedience can signal contamination.
